name: Half-Day Driver
title: Hire a Private Driver in Bangkok for Half a Day
metaDescription: Hire a private driver in Bangkok for five hours. Your own chauffeur and car, unlimited stops, driver, fuel and tolls included, extra time billed hourly.
h1: Five Hours, Entirely at Your Disposal
intro: A morning of appointments, an afternoon of shopping or an evening out that deserves better than a taxi rank. Book a private driver for five hours and your car follows your plan, stop by stop, with your chauffeur waiting outside every door.

sections.h2: The right length for most Bangkok plans
paragraphs: Five hours is the block most guests reach for first. It covers a working morning across Sathorn and Silom, a long lunch and a fitting in Siam, or a relaxed evening of dinner and a rooftop bar, without paying for a full day you will not use.

Your time begins at the agreed pickup at your address. From then on the car and chauffeur are yours: go where you like, in the order you like, and change your mind as often as the day requires. The number of stops makes no difference to the price.

Half-day hire also suits arrival day. Land in the morning, rest for a few hours, then spend a late afternoon getting your bearings with a driver who can show you where things are, how long journeys really take and which neighbourhoods are worth returning to.

Bangkok traffic follows a rhythm. Mornings build from around seven, the late afternoon is heavier still, and Friday evenings can turn a short hop into a long crawl. A half-day block works best when it sits between those peaks, roughly late morning to mid-afternoon, or after the evening rush has eased.

Your chauffeur knows which sois run one way, where a U-turn will cost ten minutes and which hotel forecourts allow a car to wait. Tell them your next stop and let them choose the approach; a calm route usually beats a short one.
If you need to be somewhere at a fixed time, say so when you book. Your chauffeur will build in a margin for the traffic, so a slow stretch on Rama IV does not become a missed appointment.

This is the real difference from ride-hailing. While you are inside a meeting, a mall or a restaurant, your driver stays close with the engine running and the air-conditioning on. Shopping bags, a laptop or a jacket can stay on the seat.
When you are ready to leave, a short message brings the car back to the entrance. In the midday heat, stepping straight from a lobby into a cool cabin is a luxury you notice within the first hour.

It also means you never have to step into the road to flag anything down. Your chauffeur handles the set-down, opens the door and deals with the attendants at busy mall entrances, so each arrival takes seconds rather than minutes.

Plans rarely end exactly on time. If your afternoon runs on, simply tell your chauffeur; additional time is billed by the hour at the overtime rate for your vehicle, subject to the driver's availability. If you suspect the day will stretch well beyond five hours, a ten-hour block is usually the better choice from the outset.

Choose the car to suit the occasion: the Toyota Camry for a discreet solo or couple's outing, an Alphard or the Rowen Vellfire Z for a family or small group, the Alphard 40 Executive Lounge when you want to rest between stops, or the Porsche Cayenne S when the arrival matters.

name: Full-Day Driver
title: Hire a Private Driver in Bangkok for a Full Day
metaDescription: Hire a private driver in Bangkok for ten hours. Your own chauffeur and vehicle from morning to evening, fuel and tolls included, overtime billed hourly.
intro: Ten hours with your own chauffeur turns Bangkok from a city you navigate into a city you simply enjoy. Breakfast meeting, temples, lunch, shopping and dinner: one car, one driver and no rebooking between any of them.

sections.h2: A whole day without a single taxi
paragraphs: A ten-hour booking is the most complete way to spend a day in Bangkok. Your chauffeur collects you at the agreed time, stays with you throughout and returns you home at the end, whether that is after an early dinner or a late evening by the river.
Because you are booking time rather than distance, you can add a stop, drop one or rearrange the whole afternoon without any discussion of fares. Driver, fuel and tolls are included.

It also removes the small frictions that add up over a long day: agreeing a fare, finding the pickup point, waiting in the sun, explaining the address again. By the evening you will have spent far more time enjoying Bangkok and far less getting around it.

A full day almost always crosses at least one rush hour, so the order of your stops matters. A good chauffeur will suggest starting on the far side of the city early, working back towards your hotel through the afternoon and keeping the evening rush for a stretch spent indoors, over a long lunch or an unhurried browse.
The Chao Phraya can be part of the plan too. Your driver can set you down at a pier for a short river crossing and be waiting on the other side, which is often faster than the bridges at busy times.

Weekends have their own pattern. Saturday markets and malls fill quickly from late morning, while Sunday mornings are often the calmest time of the week to cross the city, which makes them ideal for longer drives to the Old Town.

Over ten hours, the car becomes something like a moving hotel room. Leave a change of clothes for the evening, a bag of shopping, a laptop or a sleeping child's blanket; everything stays with your driver while you are out.

After a hot temple courtyard or a crowded market, returning to a cool, quiet cabin with cold water is the moment most guests say they will never go back to taxis. Your chauffeur is discreet throughout: present when you need them, unobtrusive when you do not.

If plans change at short notice, you only need to tell one person. Your chauffeur rearranges the route, our concierge updates anything that needs arranging, and the rest of the day carries on without fuss.

sections.h2: Inside Bangkok, and when to look further
paragraphs: The ten-hour block covers journeys within Bangkok. If your day reaches further, to Ayutthaya, the floating markets or the coast, we quote it as an outskirt or day-trip fare so the price reflects the distance. If the evening runs past ten hours, overtime is billed by the hour at your vehicle's rate.

For longer stays, a monthly package gives you an Alphard 40 or Alphard 30 with a dedicated driver seven days a week, ten hours daily and unlimited kilometres, with fuel and tolls settled separately. If you find yourself booking full days repeatedly, ask our concierge to compare the two.

name: Business Driver
title: Private Business Driver in Bangkok for Executives
metaDescription: A discreet private driver in Bangkok for executives, client meetings and roadshows. Five or ten hours, car waits between meetings, fuel and tolls included.
intro: The hours between meetings are where a business day in Bangkok is won or lost. A private business driver keeps one car and one discreet chauffeur with you all day, so you arrive composed, on time and ready to work.

sections.h2: Built for a schedule that moves
paragraphs: Book your driver for five or ten hours and work through the day exactly as it unfolds. A meeting in Sathorn overruns, a lunch moves to Thonglor, a client asks you to stop by their office in Asok; your chauffeur simply adjusts the route.

There is no rebooking between appointments and no waiting on a hot pavement for a ride that may or may not arrive. While you are inside, the car waits nearby, cool and ready, with your documents and laptop safely on the seat.
If you are joining a call from the car, tell your chauffeur; they will favour calmer roads and avoid the stop-start of the busiest junctions so you can concentrate.

Investor roadshows, supplier visits and sales days often mean six or seven stops across Silom, Sukhumvit, Rama IX and Bang Na. Your chauffeur plans the sequence with the traffic in mind and knows that the office tower's front entrance is not always the fastest place to be collected.

Many Bangkok towers have separate drop-off bays, basement car parks and security desks. Knowing which door to use, and arriving early enough to clear reception, is the quiet detail that keeps a tight programme intact.

Your chauffeur waits until you are inside before moving the car, and when you leave they are back at the right door rather than out on the main road, which matters when the next meeting is across the river.

Bangkok journeys can be long, so the car becomes part of your office. Take calls, review a presentation or prepare for the next room in peace. The Toyota Camry is understated and efficient for one or two executives; an Alphard or the Rowen Vellfire Z suits a team travelling together; and the Alphard 40 Executive Lounge gives a senior guest reclining seats and genuine privacy.
Discretion is standard. Your chauffeur is courteous, punctual and unobtrusive, and conversations in the car stay in the car.
For a visiting guest arriving straight from a long flight, preparation for the first meeting can begin in the car itself, with a quiet cabin and space to spread out notes.

Executive assistants and travel managers can book on a guest's behalf. Send the passenger name, schedule and meeting addresses on WhatsApp, and we confirm the vehicle and price in writing; changes are handled in the same thread, and our English-speaking concierge is available around the clock.

Driver, fuel and tolls are included in every block, and overtime is billed by the hour if the day runs long. For sensitive visits, a suited bodyguard can be added to the same booking. For assignments of several weeks, a monthly package may suit better.
The same thread keeps a clear written record of every pickup, vehicle and timing, which is especially useful when several colleagues arrive on different days or a programme changes overnight.

name: Family Driver
title: Private Family Driver in Bangkok with Kids & Luggage
metaDescription: A private family driver in Bangkok: room for children, pushchairs and shopping, a cool car waiting at every mall and attraction. Fuel and tolls included.
intro: Children, heat and Bangkok traffic can turn a simple day out into hard work. A private family driver keeps a cool, spacious car with you from breakfast to bedtime, ready at every mall, aquarium and restaurant door.

paragraphs: Families usually choose an Alphard or the Rowen Vellfire Z. Wide sliding doors make it easy to lift a sleepy toddler in and out, the captain's chairs give older children their own seat, and there is room behind for a folded pushchair, a nappy bag and the day's shopping.

Child seats are available on request; ask when booking and tell us the children's ages so we can confirm what is possible. If your party is larger, two cars are often more comfortable than one crowded one.
Tell us how much luggage you are bringing as well as how many people. Bangkok shopping has a way of filling a boot by mid-afternoon, and it is better to have the space than to need it.

Bangkok has plenty for children: the aquarium and the big malls around Siam, the riverside at ICONSIAM, parks, play centres and, at weekends, the bustle of Chatuchak. What it lacks is easy transport between them for a family carrying bags in the midday heat.

With your own driver, you walk out of each stop into a car that has been waiting with the air-conditioning on. No standing at a taxi rank with tired children, no folding a pushchair into a small boot, no explaining the next address.

Mall car parks fill early at weekends and during school holidays. Your chauffeur deals with the queue for the drop-off lane and the search for a space while you are already inside and the children are already pressed against the glass.

sections.h2: Pacing the day for small travellers
paragraphs: Children set the rhythm, so the plan should bend. A nap in the car between stops is often the best rest of the day, and a calm chauffeur will take the smoother route rather than the quickest one when someone is asleep.

Tell us your children's routines when you book and we will suggest a sensible order: outdoor sights early before the heat, indoor attractions in the afternoon, and home before the evening traffic builds. Your driver can also wait while one parent takes the children back to the hotel and the other carries on.
Little things help too: a spare bottle of water, a bag of snacks left in the car, a change of clothes for the inevitable spill. Everything stays where you left it until you need it.

sections.h2: Five hours, ten hours or longer
paragraphs: A five-hour block suits a morning outing; ten hours covers a full family day. Driver, fuel and tolls are included, and extra time is billed by the hour if the day runs on. For families settling into Bangkok, a monthly package with an Alphard and a dedicated driver covers school runs, weekend trips and errands seven days a week.
Want another pair of hands? A personal assistant can join as a nanny or companion, and a suited bodyguard can be added for extra peace of mind in crowded places.
Our English-speaking concierge is available around the clock if plans change in the middle of the day.

name: Driver with Bodyguard
title: Private Driver with Bodyguard in Bangkok
metaDescription: Book a private driver with a suited, English-speaking bodyguard in Bangkok. One coordinated team for five or ten hours, briefed in advance and discreet.
h1: A Driver and a Guardian, One Team
intro: Some days call for more than a good driver. Pair your private chauffeur with a suited, English-speaking bodyguard, and the two work as one team: one at the wheel, one at your side, both following the same plan.

paragraphs: Our bodyguards are only available with a SiamDrive driver booking, and that is the point. Your chauffeur and bodyguard share the same schedule, the same set-down points and the same timings, and they stay in contact throughout the day.

In practice, the bodyguard checks the entrance while the chauffeur positions the car; when you are ready to leave, the car is already at the door. Those small, coordinated moments are what separate a team from two suppliers trying to keep up with each other.
One booking also means one point of contact. Our concierge coordinates both team members, so any change to the plan reaches the person at the wheel and the person at your side at the same moment.

Your bodyguard travels in the car with you and accompanies you on foot at every stop: through hotel lobbies, into meetings, around malls and restaurants. They dress to blend in, manage doors and crowds, and keep a calm, attentive watch on your surroundings.

Their role is composure and presence rather than show. Most clients find a bodyguard is noticed less than they expected, yet makes a real difference to how relaxed the day feels, particularly late at night or in busy public places.
They are equally valuable for families. An extra watchful adult beside the children in a crowded mall or at a busy attraction lets parents relax and enjoy the day.

Before the assignment, both your chauffeur and bodyguard are briefed on your schedule, the venues and any preferences: who may approach you, where you prefer to sit, whether photographs are welcome, which entrances to avoid. What you share stays within the team.

Bangkok's busiest moments are predictable: crowded mall entrances at weekends, hotel forecourts in the evening, nightlife districts after dark. A well-briefed team plans the approach to each so you spend as little time as possible waiting in the open.

Your chauffeur, in turn, plans routes and pickup points with the bodyguard's advice in mind and keeps the car ready, so departures are quick and unhurried rather than rushed. Share as much or as little as you are comfortable with; even a short outline of your day helps.

sections.h2: Choosing the length and the car
paragraphs: The bundle is booked in five- or ten-hour blocks, matching your driver hire, with overtime billed hourly for both if the day runs long. A supplement applies if the bodyguard travels outside Bangkok. For a single airport arrival, a bodyguard can also join a transfer.

Most protection bookings use an Alphard 40, the Alphard 40 Executive Lounge or the Rowen Vellfire Z, where a spacious cabin and wide sliding doors make every arrival and departure quick and private. For larger parties or high-profile movements we can add more bodyguards, a second car or motorcycle escort riders, and we will only recommend what your situation genuinely calls for.

name: English-Speaking Driver
title: English-Speaking Private Driver in Bangkok
metaDescription: Hire an English-speaking private driver in Bangkok, backed by a 24/7 English-speaking concierge. Five or ten hours, fuel and tolls included, no guesswork.
intro: Few things are more tiring in a new city than trying to explain where you want to go. With an English-speaking private driver and a concierge who answers in English around the clock, your Bangkok day runs on plain conversation rather than pointing at a map.

paragraphs: Bangkok addresses are notoriously tricky. Hotels and restaurants often have different Thai and English names, many venues sit deep down a numbered soi, and a single wrong turn on a one-way street can add twenty minutes. Taxi drivers frequently work only from the Thai name.

Your chauffeur speaks working English for directions and the practicalities of the day. Tell them the next stop in your own words, ask how long the drive will take or where to meet afterwards, and get a clear answer.

That clarity matters most at the moments that usually go wrong: being dropped at the wrong entrance of a vast mall, agreeing where to be collected after a show, or explaining that you need a cash machine on the way.

sections.h2: A concierge in English, day and night
paragraphs: Behind every driver is our English-speaking concierge, available 24 hours a day. Your booking, changes and any questions are handled in writing, in English, so there is always a clear record of the plan.

If something needs more detailed explanation in Thai, such as a restaurant's directions, a hotel's car-park rules or a change of pickup point, the concierge relays it to your chauffeur so nothing is lost between languages.
You can write to us in English before you arrive, too, to ask which car suits your party, how long a journey takes at a particular hour or whether your plan for the day is realistic.

sections.h2: Local knowledge you can actually use
paragraphs: A driver you can talk to is also a source of practical local knowledge. Ask which malls are quieter on a weekday, when the traffic towards the river will ease, or whether a market is worth visiting in the midday heat. Your chauffeur will tell you honestly.

Our drivers are chauffeurs rather than licensed tour guides, so for in-depth history at the Grand Palace or Ayutthaya we suggest a local guide on site. For interpreting at meetings, banks or medical appointments, a personal assistant can join your booking.
Small things become easy when you can simply ask: where the nearest clean restroom is, which side of the road to wait on, or whether it is worth leaving now to beat an afternoon downpour.

Hire your English-speaking driver for five or ten hours within Bangkok, with driver, fuel and tolls included and overtime billed by the hour. The car stays with you throughout, waiting outside each stop with the air-conditioning on.

Choose the vehicle that suits you, from the discreet Toyota Camry to an Alphard for families and groups, the Alphard 40 Executive Lounge for long working days or the Porsche Cayenne S for an evening with presence. If good English matters especially for your day, mention it when booking and we will match the driver accordingly.
Once your plans are confirmed, you will have everything in writing, in English, before your driver arrives.
